draft.subject: Qinghe is 19.0% of one portfolio against a 15% limit
draft.english:
Dear [[FIRST_NAME]],

In one of your Growth portfolios, the Qinghe Battery Technology shares now make up 19.0%. The mandate for that portfolio limits any single holding to 15%, so it is 4.0 points over the limit. The holding includes the additional purchase you instructed after the first-quarter results.

That was your decision to make, and I am not questioning it. But the limit is part of what we agreed for that portfolio, so the position should either be brought back within it or recorded as a choice you have made.

What I would suggest is one of two things: we reduce the holding to the limit, or you confirm that you want to keep it as it is, and I record that on your file. Either is fine; leaving it undecided is not.

Could I call you this week?
draft.client_language:
[[FIRST_NAME]] 您好：

在您其中一个 Growth 组合中，Qinghe Battery Technology 的股份目前占 19.0%。该组合的委托协议规定任何单一持仓不得超过 15%，因此已超出上限 4.0 个百分点。这当中包括您在第一季度业绩公布后指示追加买入的部分。

那是您的决定，我并无异议。但这个上限是我们为该组合约定的内容之一，所以这项持仓要么调整回上限之内，要么记录为您作出的选择。

我建议两者择一：我们把持仓减至上限，或您确认希望维持现状，我会把这一点记录在您的档案中。两者皆可，唯独悬而未决不宜。

我可否在本周致电与您详谈？
draft.raises: Asks her to choose between trimming Qinghe to the limit or recording a decision to keep it.
